comment: LQ-20261107-1646 (operator 2026-11-09, display truth): the page showed a book total that did
not move while its marks did, a stop advice the broker had already satisfied, a header VIX that
disagreed with the CIO card and a badge tier painted against its own meter. Each is a displayed
value disagreeing with an independent recomputation, invisible to a check that only asks 'did the
lane succeed'. Pins: the 4th desk_truth_monitor check (--check display-truth, lane
display-truth-monitor) recomputes the book from positions_current x the newest Finviz quote and
compares it to the served overview/since-close/header documents; the 9-code catalog is a closed
set (a code outside config['display_truth']['catalog'] fails the tests); verdicts
OK/DEGRADED/BROKEN/UNVERIFIABLE each have a test; a stale positions snapshot or a stale in-session
quote makes the book NOT_MEASURED (UNVERIFIABLE) and never a mismatch; the stop-advice rule is
the brief's own reconcile_stop_advice, injected, never a second copy; the heal only re-dispatches
the owning lane, keyed by catalog code, and never writes a displayed value, a store or a stop;
one intent route data/display_truth_finding (DIGEST, producer desk_truth_monitor). Synthetic ZQ*
fixtures, injected clock/DB/documents; nothing here reads a real value, a broker or a credential.
